collections.title: Parks with restrooms and mapped entrances
collections.summary: Parks with a confirmed restroom and a recorded entrance; the 12 with the most confirmed facilities, of 110 that qualify.
collections.curation: Parks with a recorded restroom and entrance (a park with either unknown is left out), most confirmed facilities first, Cary first on ties, then by name; top 12 of 110 qualifying parks.

collections.title: Paved trails
collections.summary: Trails whose surface is recorded as paved; the 12 longest, of 62 that qualify.
collections.curation: Trails with a confirmed paved surface (partly paved trails are left out), longest first by the trail length computed from the greenway data, then by name; top 12 of 62 qualifying trails. This says nothing about wheelchair access.
